digest.component_or_area: PreToolUse Bash hook for Serena grep reminder
propositions: A PreToolUse hook on the Bash tool emits a short reminder when the command invokes a grep-family tool (grep, rg, egrep, fgrep).
The trigger is a plain grep-family string match with no pattern classification or path heuristics, accepting false positives by design.
The reminder message is at most three lines, names find_referencing_symbols/find_symbol as preferred, and notes grep remains correct for string-literal symbols and current line numbers.
The hook must be non-blocking: it emits JSON with additionalContext, omits permissionDecision, and never exits non-zero so it cannot deny calls or suppress prompts.
The hook config merges into the existing tracked .claude/settings.json (depending on story C) so that env.ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH survives.
An automated test executes the hook against the documented PreToolUse stdin envelope, asserting it fires on grep/rg, not on non-grep commands, and handles malformed input safely.
